steps.en: Install the CLI once and save a provider key
steps.zh: 一次性装好 CLI，并保存一个供应商 key

steps.en: Install the companion skill into the repo your agent works in
steps.zh: 在 agent 干活的仓库里装上配套 skill

steps.en: Ask the repository a natural-language question
steps.zh: 用自然语言向仓库提一个问题
steps.code: jg "How are telemetry events recorded and sent?" ./my-project

steps.en: Explores folders step by step, asking the hosted Jev model which files are relevant
steps.zh: 按目录元数据与文件预览逐层下探，问 Jev 模型哪些文件相关

component.zh: 逐层检索 + Jev 模型

steps.en: Parses Python / TS / JS declarations and picks useful source units from one snapshot
steps.zh: 解析 Python／TS／JS 声明，从同一份快照里挑出有用源码单元

component.zh: 内置 CPython + TS 解析器

steps.en: Prints summary, file leads, line-numbered verbatim excerpts and call sites to stdout
steps.zh: 把摘要、文件线索、带行号的原文片段和调用位置打到 stdout

value.en: Your agent starts unfamiliar multi-file work holding the right files and real source excerpts, instead of grepping the tree
value.zh: agent 接手陌生仓库时，开局就拿到对的文件和真实源码片段，不用再 grep 整棵树

sources: README.md: quick start (npm install -g @dzhng/jevgrep; jg auth; jg skill; jg "How are telemetry events recorded and sent?" ./my-project)
apps/cli/README.md: install/auth/doctor and jg skill usage, credentials path
docs/architecture.md: hierarchical traversal from directory metadata + content previews; separate relevance judgment; source selection; stdout layout
skills/jevgrep/SKILL.md: agent-side setup (command -v jg, npm install, jg auth by the user) and search invocation
package/apps/cli/package.json + packages/core/package.json: pyodide 0.25.1 and typescript 5.9.3 runtime deps; specs/done/jevgrep/assets/python-runtime.md: bundled CPython via Pyodide
